description: This file defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes related to blame analysis in a version control system, including structures for blame origins, blame entries, and the blame scoreboard.

methods.name: blame_origin_incref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a blame_origin object.

methods.name: blame_origin_decref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a blame_origin object.

methods.name: blame_coalesce
methods.description: Coalesces blame entries in the scoreboard.

methods.name: blame_sort_final
methods.description: Sorts the blame entries in the final order.

methods.name: blame_entry_score
methods.description: Calculates the score of a blame entry.

methods.name: assign_blame
methods.description: Assigns blame to commits based on the scoreboard.

methods.name: blame_nth_line
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the nth line in the blame.

methods.name: setup_scoreboard
methods.description: Sets up the blame scoreboard with origins.

methods.name: setup_blame_bloom_data
methods.description: Sets up bloom filter data for blame analysis.

methods.name: cleanup_scoreboard
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the scoreboard.

methods.name: blame_entry_prepend
methods.description: Prepends a blame entry to a list.

methods.name: get_blame_suspects
methods.description: Retrieves suspects for a given commit.
